Class AlgoReplayFees

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoReplayFees
public class AlgoReplayFees extends Object
What a fill of one historical replay costs, taken from the fee model the security account it settles in already carries.

A simulation environment is a copy of the portfolio, and the copy keeps the trading platform plan and the optional account level fee model of every security account. The replay therefore needs no configuration of its own: it charges what the real account would have charged, and an environment whose accounts have no model keeps costing nothing, exactly as every run did before.

One instance per run, not a bean. The resolution is cached, and two runs execute at the same time on the worker pool, so a shared cache would let one environment answer for the accounts of another.

    • cost

      public double cost(Integer idSecurityaccount, Security security, double units, double quotation, TransactionType type, LocalDate date, double fixedAssets)
      What the given order costs in the currency of the instrument, which is the currency Transaction.transactionCost is expressed in - the costs enter the amount before it is converted into the currency of the cash account.

      A model that cannot answer is an error rather than a zero. A period based model whose periods do not reach back over the replayed years, or a rule set no rule of which matches, would otherwise make exactly the trades it does not describe the cheapest ones of the run.

      Parameters:
      idSecurityaccount - where the order settles, deciding which model applies
      security - the traded instrument
      units - number of units, sign ignored
      quotation - price per unit in the currency of the instrument
      type - direction of the order
      date - the fill day, selecting the period of a time based model
      fixedAssets - what the environment is worth on that day, for a model whose fee is graded by size
      Returns:
      the cost, rounded the way money is rounded, and 0 where no model applies
